paired_interval: paired bootstrap percentile 95% CI of treatment-minus-control mean
multiple_testing: Holm within each preregistered primary claim family
family_reporting: Report every family separately; primary causal tests pool only the preregistered families attached to that claim.

sample_size.rationale: 384 keeps the preregistered universe within the 300-400 target while providing 16 deterministic/mirrored observations per structural family. Primary claims pool multiple preregistered families and use paired comparisons, increasing sensitivity relative to unpaired analysis.
sample_size.intended_primary_effects: 5-10 percentage-point paired differences for broad causal claims; exact-invariance claims require zero asymmetry on deterministic transformation families.
